_comment: The allowed dependency graph and SDK confinement, enforced by
Scripts/check-architecture.sh. SwiftPM's compiler already stops a module
importing what Package.swift does not declare; this file is the other half —
Package.swift cannot gain an edge without a decision.
Adding a key or a value here is an architecture change, so CLAUDE.md rule 2
Two properties worth naming, because they are easy to break by accident:
KamomePersistence depends on nothing internal (the domain does not depend on
the database), and KamomeExportEngine does not depend on KamomePersistence
_confined_comment: An SDK listed here may be imported only under the given path. MapKit and
Photos are deliberately NOT here: a CI comment claimed each was confined to
one file, and on 2026-08-31 that was measured false — MapKit is in 3 files
and Photos in 4, all legitimate (a live map view is not the film renderer).
The claim was wrong, not the code.
